Accomplishment
1. “Distinguished alumni” in 40 years of “Cheng-Kung Univ.” 1946-1986.

2.Published 12 research papers in major Chemical Journals: won “Young Chemist Award” in Fluorine Chemistry in 1981

3. President of Taiwanese Association of Florida (Gainesville) 1983 and Kansas 1989.

4. Chairmen of City of Tainan, Sister Cities of Kansas City, Missouri. 1996-2000

5. Founding Board Member of Asian American Chamber of Commerce. 1998-2002

6. Organized Taiwan Independence Cup annual Softball Tournament. 2006-2012

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 08/2018

--

Hobby
1.Play tennis, softball and watch football, tennis, basketball and baseball.

2.Coach in children’s soccer, baseball and softball.

3.Reading daily sporting newspaper and sporting magazines.
